sentences.text: Amoxicillin also spelled amoxycillin , is an antibiotic useful for the treatment of a number of bacterial infections .	antibiotic	antibiotic
It is the first line treatment for middle ear infections .	middle ear infections	acute otitis media
It may also be used for strep throat , pneumonia , skin infections , and urinary tract infections among others .	strep throat	strep throat	pneumonia	pneumonia	skin infections	cellulitis
It is taken by mouth , or less commonly by injection .
Common side effects include nausea and rash .
It may also increase the risk of yeast infections and , when used in combination with clavulanic acid , diarrhea .	yeast infections	candidiasis	clavulanic acid	clavulanic acid	diarrhea	diarrhea
It should not be used in those who are allergic to penicillin .	penicillin	penicillin
While usable in those with kidney problems , the dose may need to be decreased .
Its use in pregnancy and breastfeeding does not appear to be harmful .	pregnancy	pregnancy	breastfeeding	breastfeeding
Amoxicillin was discovered in 1958 and came into medical use in 1972 .
It is on the World Health Organization 's List of Essential Medicines , the most effective and safe medicines needed in a health system .	health system	health system
It is one of the most commonly prescribed antibiotics in children .
Amoxicillin is available as a generic medication .	generic medication	generic medication
It has a wholesale cost in the developing world of between 0.02 and 0.05 USD per pill .	developing world	developing world
In the United States ten days of treatment costs about 16 USD .

causal_questions.question: Amoxicillin is more common received by mouth than by injection.
